t: The reference board for Cologne Chip's GateMate FPGA, made in Germany.
steps: Buy the CCGM1A1-E1 kit from DigiKey. It includes the board, a programmer adapter, and cables.
Read the toolchain install guide from Cologne Chip.
Install the OSS CAD Suite. It bundles Yosys, nextpnr, and openFPGALoader.
On Windows, install the Zadig driver for the FTDI USB chip.
Plug the board into your computer with the USB cable.
Build the blink example and load it with openFPGALoader.
Change the blink speed in the Verilog file and load it again.
meta: Open Board. From $248. A few stores.
